subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Product manufacturing process
statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis at 37.0°C using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT; mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C; LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at 25 mL/min flow rate; Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C; Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at Ambient conditions; and Fill-Finish with Vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 environment. All steps resulted in PASS status.
